name: DOCShapeAXI
description: Classify each 3D surface, and paint the reason for it onto the mesh.

surfaces.description: A `.vtk` surface, or a folder of them (searched recursively).

model.description: The checkpoint to use. Its name says which anatomy is being graded, on what scale, and with which network -- upstream asked for all four separately, so a caller could pair a two-class model with a four-class scale and be handed a severity grade the network was never trained to produce.

output_dir.description: Where the explained surfaces and the report are written.

explain.description: Also compute the GradCAM attribution and write it onto each surface as a point array. Off, only the predictions are produced, which is several times faster.

output_suffix.description: Appended to each written surface's stem.

device.description: `cuda` or `cpu`. Falls back to `cpu` with a warning when no CUDA device is visible.
